scope: All 22 external-versus-ORM reference-only indexes without an exact candidate in the verified PG16 catalog. Add the exact named declarations without dropping aliases, replacing standalone unique indexes with constraints, or modifying deployed migrations. Other name/definition/dependency differences remain open.

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "so_kefu_customer_orders"
  ON "store_order" ("uid", "id" DESC)
  WHERE "is_system_del" = 0
    AND "is_del" = 0
    AND "store_id" = 0
    AND "pid" = 0
    AND "refund_type" IN (0, 1, 3, 6);

catalog.name: so_kefu_customer_orders
catalog.definition: public.store_order USING btree (uid, id DESC) WHERE ((is_system_del = 0) AND (is_del = 0) AND (store_id = 0) AND (pid = 0) AND (refund_type = ANY (ARRAY[0, 1, 3, 6])))
